mechanism_narrative: A persistently low federal funds rate compresses the risk-free rate, reducing the discount rate for equity valuations and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS is below 0.1%.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the unemployment rate below 5.0% signals an overheating labor market, prompting monetary tightening and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when UNRATE is below 5.0%.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous acceleration in housing starts and retail sales above their respective thresholds indicates robust consumer demand, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when HOUST > 1550 and RSAFS > 541000.

mechanism_narrative: In an expansionary economic regime, a decline in industrial production below 105.0 signals a potential supply shock, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when the economy is in an expansionary regime and INDPRO < 105.0.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in the consumer price index above 262.0 signals accelerating inflation, prompting the Federal Reserve to tighten policy and generate negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when CPIAUCSL > 262.0.

mechanism_narrative: Strong job growth, as measured by a high level of non-farm payrolls, supports consumer spending and corporate profits, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when PAYEMS is above its 12-month average.

mechanism_narrative: Robust housing market activity, indicated by high housing starts, signals strong consumer demand and economic growth, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when HOUST is above 1500.

mechanism_narrative: Strong industrial production growth, as measured by a high level of industrial production, indicates robust manufacturing activity and economic expansion, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO is above 105.0.
